meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES per night for a family of 2 adults + up to 3 children at standard rates. Holiday/school-holiday pricing will be higher. Always verify on the official website.

properties.name: Paradise Resort Gold Coast
properties.description: Australia's best family resort — 2 waterparks with 5 waterslides, giant tipping bucket, junior splash zone, free kids club (0-12 years), daily activities, ice-skating rink, playground, family rooms that sleep 5–6, two-bedroom options with kitchenette. Walking distance to Surfers Paradise beach.
properties.bestFor: Families who want waterpark thrills without leaving the hotel — built entirely around kids.

properties.name: Turtle Beach Resort
properties.description: Award-winning family resort — splash zone waterpark, 4 pools including toddler pool, games room, cinema, putt-putt mini golf, tennis court, fitness centre. All apartments are self-contained with full kitchen and laundry. Set in lush tropical gardens 200m from Mermaid Beach.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting resort-style facilities with full apartment living — kitchens mean you self-cater.

properties.name: Sea World Resort
properties.description: Directly connected to Sea World theme park — themed family rooms, lagoon-style swimming pool with shallow wading area, kids activity centre, characters on-site, buffet breakfast available. Spit beach walking distance.
properties.bestFor: Sea World fans — wake up and walk straight into the park. Annual pass bundles often available.

properties.name: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa
properties.description: Recently refurbished luxury family resort — famous saltwater lagoon pool with waterslides, tropical fish and snorkelling, freshwater pool, private saltwater beach, dedicated kids club, multiple restaurants. Premium family experience.
properties.bestFor: Families who want luxury AND waterslides — the best of both worlds. Worth the splurge for a shorter stay.

properties.name: Mantra on View
properties.description: Value-packed apartment hotel one block from Surfers beach — full kitchens, ocean-view rooms available, outdoor pool, close to Cavill Ave restaurants and shops. Simple, clean, no-frills. Good base for families on a tight budget.
properties.bestFor: Budget-conscious families who just need a clean comfortable base and want self-catering.

properties.name: Meriton Suites Surfers Paradise
properties.description: Modern high-rise apartment suites — indoor and outdoor pools, spa, sauna, full kitchens and laundries, spacious living areas, some rooms with ocean views, secure parking. Walk to beach and Cavill Ave. Two-bedroom suites comfortable for families of 5.
properties.bestFor: Families who want apartment space + kitchen at hotel quality — solid middle-ground pick.

properties.name: QT Gold Coast
properties.description: Design-forward hotel with a fun, vibrant vibe — outdoor pool, spaQ (day spa), Yamagen Japanese restaurant on-site, Bazaar interactive marketplace dining. Family suites available. Beach across the road. Stylish without being stuffy.
properties.bestFor: Families who want style and great on-site dining — Bazaar buffet is a family dinner event.

properties.name: Peppers Soul Surfers Paradise
properties.description: Gold Coast's tallest residential tower — absolute beachfront, floor-to-ceiling ocean views, stunning infinity pool, spa, gym, luxury apartments with full kitchens. Two-bedroom apartments sleep 5-6. Steps from the sand.
properties.bestFor: Families celebrating a special occasion — luxury apartment living with unbeatable views.

properties.name: The Star Grand at The Star Gold Coast
properties.description: Luxury resort hotel in Broadbeach — lagoon pool with cabanas, multiple restaurants (Garden Kitchen & Bar, Kiyomi, Cucina Vivo), day spa. Walking distance to Pacific Fair and the beach. Family rooms available.
properties.bestFor: Families who want restaurants, pool luxury, and Pacific Fair shopping at the door.

properties.name: Sheraton Grand Mirage Resort
properties.description: Absolute beachfront luxury — massive lagoon-style pool, direct beach access, Terraces Restaurant (seafood buffet), Oyster Bar, day spa, lush tropical gardens. Family suites and interconnecting rooms. A Gold Coast icon.
properties.bestFor: Beachfront luxury for families — the pool alone keeps kids entertained all day.

properties.name: Crowne Plaza Surfers Paradise
properties.description: Twin-tower hotel in central Surfers — outdoor pool with kids splash area, family dining, close to tram stop, secure parking. Reliable chain-hotel quality with generous family rooms.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting predictable chain-hotel comfort in the heart of Surfers.

properties.name: Novotel Surfers Paradise
properties.description: Solid mid-range hotel across from the beach — outdoor pool, restaurant, bar, family rooms with 2 double beds, kids stay and eat free (conditions apply). Reliable family pick close to the G:link tram.
properties.bestFor: A straightforward, affordable, hassle-free family stay — no surprises, kids eat free deal.

properties.name: The Star Residences — Rhythm Broadbeach
properties.description: Modern apartment tower — full kitchens and laundries, pool with sun deck, gym, walk to Pacific Fair (300m) and the beach (400m), secure parking. Clean, contemporary apartment living at a great Broadbeach location.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting Broadbeach at apartment prices — Pacific Fair is your back yard.

properties.name: Q1 Resort & Spa
properties.description: Australia's tallest residential tower — 2 lagoon pools, indoor pool, spa, steam room, full kitchens. One and two-bedroom apartments with spectacular views. SkyPoint Observation Deck on-site. Walk to beach, tram at doorstep.
properties.bestFor: Iconic Gold Coast address with apartment practicality — the SkyPoint deck on-site is a bonus.

properties.name: BreakFree Diamond Beach
properties.description: Family-oriented apartment hotel — outdoor lagoon pool, kids wading pool, tennis court, games room. Short walk to Broadbeach dining strip and beach. Generous two-bedroom apartments with kitchen, laundry, spacious living areas.
properties.bestFor: Active families — tennis, games room, pool, walk to everything in Broadbeach.

properties.name: Oaks Gold Coast Hotel
properties.description: Great-value apartment hotel opposite the beach — outdoor pool, heated spa, full kitchens in all apartments, views of ocean or hinterland. One of the most affordable family-friendly apartment stays on the central Gold Coast.
properties.bestFor: Families watching every dollar — the cheapest solid option with a full kitchen and pool.

properties.name: Burleigh Beach Tower
properties.description: Beachfront apartments in the heart of Burleigh — outdoor pool, tennis court, full kitchens and laundries, direct access to Burleigh beach and headland walking tracks. Walk to James Street village cafes. Family holiday classic.
properties.bestFor: Burleigh lovers — beach, headland, village cafes all on foot, no car needed.

properties.name: Mantra Coolangatta Beach
properties.description: Beachfront apartment living at the southern end — outdoor pool and spa, full kitchens, ocean-view apartments, walk to Coolangatta beach, Snapper Rocks, and Greenmount. Quiet family favourite. Close to Gold Coast Airport (10 min drive).
properties.bestFor: Families wanting beautiful southern beaches, surf vibe, and quick airport access.

properties.name: Palazzo Versace Gold Coast
properties.description: Iconic 5-star luxury on the Main Beach waterfront — lagoon pool with sandy beach, marble interiors, private marina, kids stay-and-eat-free offers in school holidays. The flagship treat-yourself stay on the Coast.
properties.bestFor: Families who want the full 5-star wow factor and a lagoon pool the kids will never leave.

properties.name: The Langham, Gold Coast
properties.description: Absolute beachfront 5-star tower at Jewel — indoor and outdoor pools, day spa, residence suites with full kitchens, direct beach access and Langham afternoon tea.
properties.bestFor: Premium beachfront with apartment-style space for families who want luxury AND a kitchen.

properties.name: Peppers Broadbeach
properties.description: Twin-tower luxury apartments in the heart of Broadbeach — full kitchens and laundries, podium pool, steam rooms, zen garden, 200m walk to the beach, cafes and Pacific Fair.
properties.bestFor: Spacious premium apartments walkable to everything in Broadbeach.

properties.name: Dorsett Gold Coast
properties.description: Stylish mid-range hotel inside The Star precinct — rooftop recreation deck with pool, easy monorail access, interconnecting family rooms and casino-precinct dining downstairs.
properties.bestFor: Polished mid-range base with resort perks at a fair price.

properties.name: voco Gold Coast
properties.description: Stylish mid-range hotel between Surfers and Broadbeach — two pools including a rooftop with skyline views, family rooms, and a short stroll to the beach and light rail.
properties.bestFor: Polished stay with a rooftop pool at a sensible price.

properties.name: Vibe Hotel Gold Coast
properties.description: Fresh, modern rooms on the riverfront end of Surfers — outdoor pool, easy walking to Cavill Ave, and some of the best-value modern rooms on the strip.
properties.bestFor: Modern budget base without motel vibes.

properties.name: Ruby Gold Coast
properties.description: Newer apartment towers with a resort pool, waterslide, splash zone, kids play area, mini-golf and full kitchens — built with families in mind, one street back from the beach.
properties.bestFor: Apartment space + waterslide fun in one package.

properties.name: Rydges Gold Coast Airport
properties.description: Right at Coolangatta airport and minutes from Kirra and Cooly beaches — rooftop bar, pool, and a smart base for the southern beaches at a fair price.
properties.bestFor: Fly-in families doing the southern Gold Coast.

properties.name: Surfers Paradise Marriott Resort & Spa
properties.description: Famous lagoon pool with its own sandy beach, snorkelling with tropical fish, waterslide, swim-up bar and kids club — a resort day never leaves the property.
properties.bestFor: The lagoon-pool resort experience — snorkel without leaving the hotel.
